entry.title: Liminal Hz 1.3.0
entry.summary: ### New - **LONG IR** (Gen 1): a button under Reverse that brings Gen 2's IR quality to the Force and Gen 1 MPCs: IRs up to **20 s** instead of 5 (so Decay 300% on a 5 s room rings its full ~15 s), band-limited sinc resampling for IRs at other sample rates and for Stretch (no dulled top octave, no alias tones), and Decay analysed at twice the frequency detail. entry.summary: ### New - **Gen 2 build (MPC Live III and other RK3588 units, 64-bit).** The release now carries a second zip, `Liminal-Hz-<version>-mpc-aarch64.zip`, next to the Gen 1 one: the same plugin (same id, uid, parameters, presets and page), so a project moves between generations.
